data.resumo: I gave a lost tourist a two-hour tour

data.mensagem: Mum, I'm so sorry, I'm going to be two hours late. With the roadworks on the A1 and the Metro disrupted, a lost tourist begged me for directions. I ended up giving him a two-hour guided tour. Please save me a bit of the roast kid!

desculpa_absurda.titulo: A tourist asked me for directions and I gave him a two-hour guided tour

cenas.legenda: Ele quer ver tudo, até ao fim
Chego por fim, cansado e cheio de história

entrevista.titulo: O turista que não queria ir embora
entrevista.entrevistada: Hans, a curious tourist who got lost near the Ribeira

perguntas.p: Why did you ask him for directions?
perguntas.r: My map was upside down. He seemed to know the way, and he was so kind.

perguntas.p: Did you really need two hours?
perguntas.r: There was the Ribeira, the bridge and a francesinha. Everything deserved a proper explanation.
Sorry, madam. Your son is an excellent guide. Please keep him some roast kid.

resposta1.texto: A TOURIST?? 😱😱 Darling, did you EAT anything today?? 🍽️😰
And two hours of walking with a stranger?! 😭 What if he wasn't really lost?? 🙏😱😱
Also the roast kid is NOT going to wait for you, I'm warning you 🐐😤

conversa.texto_link: Mum, I swear, he even gave an interview. Look: diariodobico.pt/exclusivo 🙏

noticia_link.manchete: Lost Tourist Hans Refuses to Leave Local Guide: 'Two Hours Were Not Enough!'
noticia_link.lead: A curious German visitor, lost near the Ribeira, says a stranger's guided tour, complete with bridge and francesinha, was the highlight of his trip.

reacao_link.texto: HANS?? 😱 He says you are an EXCELLENT guide?! 🥹😭 Oh my darling, I'm so proud and so worried 💕😰
He wants me to keep you roast kid?? 🐐😍 Fine, but I want to speak to this Hans right now, and did he feed you the francesinha?? 🍽️😤

mensagens.texto: Good evening, madam! Your son is a wonderful guide. The Ribeira, the bridge, the francesinha, all true!
He even made sure I ate properly. Please do not be cross, I am the one who kept him. Sorry! 🙏

reacao_final.texto: Oh, Hans, you lovely man 😭💕 Well, if he ate, then all is forgiven! 🍽️✨
Now come home, both of you, the roast kid is getting cold!! 🐐🏠❤️

votos.comentario: Oh filho, a Avó Rosa já viu muita coisa, mas um guia turístico de duas horas por causa de uma indicação? Quem dá guias com tanto zelo ao estrangeiro devia dar o mesmo à mãe, que esperou pelo cabrito assado! Ainda assim, ficas com uns pontinhos por pedires um bocadinho do cabrito com educação, que quem pede com jeito, algo leva.

Not a single gull in the whole story, and you expect me to stay awake? A two-hour tour of the Ribeira without a single gull swooping in to steal a pastel de nata is a crime against tourism, and the evidence is as simulated as your punctuality.

Every shred of evidence is labelled 'simulated data', and a two-hour guided tour for one lost tourist is not an excuse, it's a tourism board proposal. Also, the Blue line is not 'Line A', and the roast deserves better than this fiction. One point for the roast, which at least sounds real.
